_comment: Manual Keybase identity overrides for Gno validators. Priority: manual > AtomOne auto-match. Keys (any of these, case-insensitive): moniker | operatorAddress (g1…) | signingAddress (g1…). Value = Keybase identity hash (16 hex chars). Address keys preferred — moniker is mutable. Lookup order: operator → signing → moniker. Helper: node scripts/keybase-lookup.mjs <username>. Example: "g1abc...": "A2E180C6914F7F87" or "MyValidator": "A2E180C6914F7F87".
